36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
78093: Hitohito Tadano is a person average in almost every way. His name means, *just some guy*. He is the first to befriend Shouko Komi. Tadano is often described as an ordinary student with normal looks and average height and weight.
121956: Shouko Komi is the main character of the series. Though she's regarded as the *Madonna* of their school, she's incapable of socializing with others to such a level where it can be called a communication disorder.
126825: Najimi is a mysterious student whose gender is unknown. They are talented enough at communicating to easily befriend someone within minutes of meeting them. Growing up, Najimi was constantly transferring from one school to another, allowing them to make millions of friends.
127449: Rumiko Manbagi is a gyaru girl who enters the second year of school with no friends. She becomes friends with Shouko Komi and Hitohito Tadano, her being the first Komi was able to befriend alone.
128378: A student who usually speaks in dubious speech as a result of being a chuunibyou. She states that she was Arsot Les Primavera and that Shouko Komi is Princess Komilia.
130865: Masayoshi Komi is Shouko's and Shousuke's father. He is seen as a dandy middle-aged man. Masayoshi rarely speaks and sometimes struggles to express himself verbally and can, at times, be easily flustered.
130867: Shuuko Komi, formerly known as Shuuko Nimi, is Shouko and Shousuke's mother. She looks like her daughter, but her personality is that of a teenager, claiming to be forever 17 years old.
130868: With the face of a delinquent, Katai is actually a nervous, awkward wreck who constantly stumbles over his words, with a goal to overcome his own awkwardness and make friends.
130869: Himiko Agari is introduced as a shy insecure girl. She also runs a ramen shop review blog and considers herself a "ramen expert."
130870: Shousuke Komi is Shouko's younger brother. He's quiet most of the time but can converse well. Shousuke has short trimmed hair and his eyes are usually hidden with his bangs. Still, his very appearance is similar to his mother and sister and can be referred to as a handsome man.
130871: Makeru Yadano is a competitive girl who likes to compete herself to Shouko.
130873: Sadayoshi Komi is Shouko's uncle and her father's brother. Shouko thinks she gets along well with him because they have similar personality just like her father.
130874: Ren Yamai is one of Komi Shouko's classmates from Class 1-1.
130875: Yuiko Komi is Shouko, Akira, and Shousuke's grandmother. She's strict but gentle towards her family. When visiting, she usually challenges them to games.
130876: Akira Komi is Shousuke and Shouko's cousin. She was originally scared of Shouko before because of Shouko's inability to speak and constant staring at Akira silently. The two become close during her Udon festival visit after Shouko tickled her.
130877: Ryokuo Komi is Shouko's aunt. She is just as lively as Shouko's mother so she sometimes unknowingly intimidate Shouko.
130878: Hitomi Tadano is the younger sister of Hitohito Tadano. She bears resemblance to her brother in terms of understanding people's minds. She is active, unlike her brother who is timid and more passive in doing things.
130879: Nokoko Inaka is a with a complex about her coming from the countryside. She later became friends with Shouko.
158374: Chusaku Kometani is introduced with Naruse Shisuto to commentate on his inner thoughts.
158375: Onigashima Akako is originally part of Yamai Ren's friend group. Her name translates to Red Girl from Oni Island which is a reference to the tale of Momotarou.
158376: Satou Amami is a student in class 1-1. Her name translaters to sweet as sugar.
158377: Naruse is a person who believes that all people are his fans and the reason he is not approached is because others think he is too good for them too talk to. All of his thoughts are commentated on by Kometani Chuusaku.
160201: Odoka Shizuka is a second-year at Itan Private High School
160203: Chika Netsuno is a student one year above Tadano, Shouko, and Najimi, and serves as Shouko's athletic rival.
160204: Ase Shibuki is one of Shouko's classmates and friends. She's always seen sweating.
160209: Gorimi is a student one year above the main characters. She is the Head Librarian, and the disciplinarian of Itan Private High School.
160210: Emoyama Yuragi is a third-year at Itan Private High School.
160215: Kiyoko Isagi is a classmate of Shouko, and is the current Student Council President, having been elected to replace Ichou Setoka. During her second year of middle school, Isagi's mother told her to wipe a table.
160216: Sukida Lily is a second-year at Itan Private High School. Lily is occasionally seen in the background shipping her classmates together, feverishly writing on a clipboard. One of her favorites is "Yama x Naka".
160217: Toutoi Son is a student in Shouko's class. Despite his looks, he isn't very noble. He's introduced in Chapter 130, where he's forced to introduce himself by telling an embarrassing story. During middle school a girl saw him pick up a porn magazine by the riverside.
160218: Karisu Maki is Komi Shouko's hair dresser. Karisu is seen to be very professional with her clients. When Komi comes in to her shop Karisu is able to understand exactly what she wants even without Komi speaking to her.
160221: Chiarai Shigeo is a student in class 1-1. Chiarai is friends with Sonoda and Shinobino.
160222: Shinobino Mono is a student in class 1-1. He is friends with Chiarai and Sonoda. The three are most prominently seen in Volume 6 Chapters 75 and 77 where the three discuss which of the girls in class (+Najimi) would be the best to date.
160223: Ramen Darou is the chain restaurant that Shouko, Tadano, Najimi, and Agari visit in Chapter 28, due to Shouko's dream being to visit a ramen shop. The Shopkeeper is the cook and owner of Itan's Ramen Darou. He speaks extremely quietly, and is also bad at communicating.
160224: Sonoda Taisei is a student in class 1-1. Sonoda is friends with Chiarai and Shinobino. The three are most prominently seen in Volume 6 Chapters 75 and 77 where the three discuss which of the girls in class (+Najimi) would be the best to date.
160225: Hoshiko first appears in pages 8-9 of Chapter 43 "Part Time Job", where Komi is handing out pocket tissues, and Hoshiko really needs some tissues. Hoshiko sees Komi, but going to get a handout herself is awfully desperate.
160227: Katou Mikuni is a member of Komi's group for the year 1 field trip. Katou is one-third of Komi's first-year field trip group. She and Sasaki Ayami make a pact to make sure the trip is as fun as possible for Komi.
160228: Sasaki Ayami is a member of Komi's group for the year 1 field trip. She made a pact with Katou Mikuni to make sure the trip is as fun as possible for Komi. She is also very talented with yo-yos.
249856: An airhead who likes to take things slow, to the point where she kept on watching a fireplace recording from Christmas to New Year's Day.
270955: Himeko is an enigmatic girl who appears as part of Ren Yamai's troupe of popular girls.
280386: Chocolate is a black cat that lives at the Cat Cafe Gateau.
281440: Maeda is a student at Itan Private High School.
282322: Kawai is the girl who rejected Tadano in middle school.
